title: The root-limit comparison is a linear isomorphism after identifying coefficients
statement: Let l be prime and X a Noetherian scheme on which l is invertible in global sections. Let e be any coefficient-ring isomorphism satisfying every finite reduction normalization of [lem-diagonal-completed-coefficient-ring-comparison], and let roots be any IntegralRoots l (bottomField l) X of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams]. Restrict purTwistZlModule along e.hom. There is an isomorphism of sectionwise modules from this restriction to the sectionwise realization of zlLine l X under [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], whose underlying abelian sheaf map is exactly roots.hom. This concerns one specified module and its map, not an equivalence of module categories.

source.place: paragraph (1), initial completed coefficient identification; expanded in lem-diagonal-completed-coefficient-realization, steps 1--3

proof.text: Choose the normalized linear finite projections supplied by lem-diagonal-completed-root-projection-linear. Their underlying maps are the prescribed root projections followed by the free units. Compatibility follows by comparing them to roots.hom composed with the integral-limit projections. Restriction of internal scalars preserves limits, as a right adjoint; sectionModuleEquivalence preserves limits, as an equivalence. Lift this cone to a linear morphism to the actual integral limit.

Forgetting internal scalars preserves the integral limit. Its projections jointly distinguish the underlying map of this linear lift from roots.hom; both have exactly the prescribed finite projection equations.

The free units form a natural transformation from the root tower to the underlying finite integral twist tower: tensor-map naturality of the free unit and the specified coefficient/root transitions give its adjacent squares. Every component is an isomorphism by lem-diagonal-bottom-finite-root-unit-is-iso. Its induced limit map is therefore an isomorphism. Compose it with the inverse of the forgetful limit-preservation isomorphism. The normalized projection equations identify this composite with roots.hom. The sectionwise forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, so the linear lift is invertible; its associated isomorphism has the required underlying map.

proof_origin.place: Finite normalized scalar maps and finite bottom-ring tensor units, assembled by limit preservation and reflection of isomorphisms. Agent-written categorical assembly; replaces the local-trivialization route.

theorem completedCoefficientRootLineComparison_exists (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤)))
    (e : (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) X)) ≅
        Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion X l))
    (he : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map e.inv ≫
            (purZlReduction l X (n + 1)).hom =
          (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map
              ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
                (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).map
                  (Scheme.purTwistZlProjection X l n)) ≫
            (sfbConstantRingAbIso X
              (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod (l ^ (n + 1)))))).hom)
    (roots : IntegralRoots l (bottomField l) X) :
    ∃ s : (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars e.hom).obj (Scheme.purTwistZlModule X l) ≅
        (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionModuleEquivalence.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
          (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) X)).functor.obj
            (zlLine l X),
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map s.hom = roots.hom
